description: The bar chart illustrates the sample count of different essay types, categorized by their status as "Open" or "Cons." The horizontal axis represents the categories, labeled as "Narrative", "Descriptive", and "Expository", in that order. The vertical axis is labeled "Sample Count" and has a linear scale ranging from 20 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 20. Each category is represented by a pair of bars, with "Open" bars colored blue and "Cons." bars colored pink. The "Narrative" category has an "Open" bar with a value of 79 and a "Cons." bar with a value of 122; the "Descriptive" category has values of 80 and 87, respectively; and the "Expository" category has values of 68 and 100. The bars are grouped by category, with the "Open" and "Cons." bars appearing side by side for each category. The chart does not display any specific sorting order among the categories, and no bars are visually emphasized.
